Brand foundations

Get clear before getting visual.

A strong visual direction starts with a shared understanding of the business.

01

What do you offer?

Describe the offer in plain language. Make clear who it helps and what people need to understand first. A focused description gives the design work a useful starting point.

02

What makes it yours?

Identify the choices, values, and character that distinguish the business. Use real examples rather than a list of broad adjectives. The most useful brand stories connect what you say with what you do.

03

Where must it work?

List the places the brand appears: a website, packaging, social content, presentations, or physical spaces. These touchpoints help shape a connected visual system with practical uses in mind.
